title: Synthesis Result File
description: A muninn synthesis result file (contract muninn-synthesis/1, docs/synthesis-contract.md). It names the emitted task it answers by task_id, attempt and task_digest; output is validated separately against the task's result_schema.

runner.description: Free-text name of the harness that ran the task, e.g. 'claude-code-local'. Recorded for audit.
